layers.authority: Namibian Ministry of Environment, Forestry and Tourism (MEFT)
layers.process: Khaudum National Park: MEFT says visitors must travel in a convoy of at least two vehicles, with no more than one vehicle towing a trailer. Check the current arrangements and road conditions with the park before setting out.

sources.title: Park entry permit requirements
sources.authority: Namibian Ministry of Environment, Forestry and Tourism (MEFT)

laws.rule: Khaudum National Park: For Khaudum (spelt Khuadum in the ministry FAQ), MEFT states visitors require a convoy of two or more vehicles and only one vehicle may tow a trailer. The named park page separately recommends at least two 4x4 vehicles, three days of food per person and 100 litres of water per vehicle. The recommendation is not presented as a criminal-law threshold; verify operational access with MEFT before departure.
